The CCP system seems to work best when people are having to "work" for their CCP, so why not have them have to work to maintain it. For example remove 1% of a users CCP total daily. As a show thought post pointed out, "Everyone is being nice to each other in order to get upvoats, so they can later downvoat each other." In order to make this work with subverse CCP tracking, the CCP points should be eliminate in the order in which they were accumulated. So if you were once active in a particular subverse but are no longer, your points in that subverse would decay first.

That's stupid.

It doesn't stop people from jerking off on each other for CCP. In fact, now you're suggesting that they need to be forced into spamming useless comments in order to avoid their decay loss. Holy shit. The CP whores and brigade's already have a major advantage of clearing a relatively small CCP hurdle. They will already be spamming comments in order to achieve high levels of CCP. The smaller factions will be unable to sustain a workable level of CCP. The decay will do the work of the brigades without them having to waste any personal down votes.

The real weakness of CCP will be discovered during the first invasion of one subverse into another.

I think the key is Subverses need to enable there own individual CCP limits instead of just following the site limits. The subverse CCP thresholds only count CCP earned in that subverse. That alone shuts brigading down pretty hard. The purpose of decay is to keep people from being able to stay on top without having to continue to contribute. Combine that with my other idea on CCP management, limiting the amount of CCP that a user can recieve from any one comment and I think it's a pretty solid system.

  • Encourage subverses to enable subverse level CCP thresholds for down voting. This prevent brigading, as the brigaders will not have the CCP necessary to down vote post. Currently subverses are not doing this because it removes them from /v/all. This is understandable as a sub where down votes are more limited would have an unfair advantage. For this reason a formula needs to be created to "scale" a post rating on /v/all so it fairly competes regardless of the original subverses voting rules.

  • Implement CCP decay to encourage continuing to participate in a community instead of allowing them to lord over it after some arbitrary amount of CCP has been obtained. Combined with the first point, this means to downvote in a sub you will need to continue to positively contribute to that sub. Have CCP decay in the order it was achieved so that CCP earned in a subverse a user is no longer active in would decay first.

  • Limit the maximum amount of CCP a single post can generate. While up votes and down votes would need to continue to display correctly, a single post which receives massive amounts of CCP for appealing to the hive mind should not set that user up for life. This would also make appealing to the hive mind for CCP less rewarding.

  • Do not allow users to view the CCP of another user. This prevents people from just agreeing with "popular" users.

I think those 4 changes would make CCP an extremely powerful tool, brigading is protected against, users are kept engaged, and mobility in the user "caste" system is protected. % decay and CCP to down vote threshold would both have to be tweaked to find optimal values, but I believe the concept is sound.
